# Derek Johnson

> Derek Johnson is a Senior Software Engineer with 10+ years of experience building production software, primarily in fintech and SaaS, with deep Angular and TypeScript architecture experience. He currently works at Forta Solutions | Agility and focuses on front-end architecture, GraphQL API design, and AI-assisted engineering workflows.
